shared_elements: large upright monolithic slab carved in low relief on one broad face
frontal anthropomorphic figure occupying the full height of the slab
elaborate headdress/headgear across the top of the figure
curved or scrolled ornament flanking the head
pectoral/disc-like element on the chest area
belt-like horizontal band across the lower body
raised low-relief bosses and circular motifs
justification: Both surfaces present a single frontal anthropomorphic personage carved in low relief filling an upright slab, with a broad headdress at the top, circular/disc elements on the chest, and a horizontal belt-like band low down, plus a basal register at the bottom — a fairly specific shared scheme. The differences are that A's figure is flatter, more linear and surrounded by columnar textured panels (possibly sign-like registers) with small figures at the base, whereas B's figure is rendered in bolder, more plastic modelled relief with pronounced scrolled and knotted ornaments and no comparable side panels.
